description: Translate a reviewed project data contract into validation and ownership requirements while leaving connector changes unexecuted.

guide.applicability: Use when source, destination, schema owner, freshness and privacy requirements are known.
guide.context_boundary: Configuration text cannot authorize deployment, credentials, network access or mutation of a source or destination.
steps: Resolve the source, destination, schema, identity, freshness, retention and privacy owners.
Compare requirements with current registered read capabilities and any governed connector contract.
Return a proposal, validation plan and unresolved ownership gaps; do not deploy or modify integration state.
guide.title: Data integration proposal review

summary: Produce a bounded integration proposal without configuring external systems.
